lines.en: Once again, Chika Chosokabe arrives at a party as what most would call “fashionably late.” But in all actuality, fashion had very little to do with it.

Because, yes — she may have struggled getting her corset to hug her body just tightly enough to perfectly accentuate her waist without crushing her insides, but she would have been late regardless of that.

In fact, she was close to not coming at all. For being here and seeing her was sure to set off the same alarms she failed so miserably to turn off the night she acquired a taste for the flesh of a friend.
Rabies had turned to cannibalism. And while that was slightly less dangerous from an outsider’s perspective, it was a lot more socially unacceptable because there would need to be intent to it.
It was personally unacceptable too. Yet Chika threw herself into the fire again and wasn’t really sure why now that she was burning.
Was it the same sort of compulsion that drives one to poke a bruise, she wondered? Or like wiggling a baby-tooth on a journey from mouth-to-sheet?
Because, if that were the case, she could take solace in the fact that it would only be temporary. And that soon, she would be “normal” again.
But a part of her wished it would last forever. And a part of her felt like the taste that still lingered in her mouth would be so much sweeter if she could only indulge again.
: Rin! Look!
: Oh hey, Chika! You-
: Woah. That, uhh...
: Woah.
: I can rock Jirai Kei pretty well, right? Like, maybe I’ll start dressing this way outside of Christmalloween?
: Right. Yeah. My nose isn’t bleeding, is it?
: Not yet, no. So you’ve either become stronger or just don’t find me cute anymore.
: “Cute” would be an understatement right now. You look like the type of girl I’d want to receive threatening text messages from.
: Can you be more specific? Because I’ll send them right now if it will get your nose to bleed. I crave the ego boost and I’m wearing more clothes than normal this year.
: Oh, you know. Just the kind that tell me I’m not allowed to look at other people and that I need to be fully devoted to you or you’ll kill yourself and blame it all on me.
: Oh. Well, how about I just send you a selfie instead? I have a few from when I was trying stuff on at the mall.
: You’ll be forced to see me in my underwear, though. Hope that’s okay.
: Yup. There it goes. There’s the nosebleed. Thanks, Chika. Appreciate that.
: Fuck yeah! Still got it!
: Come with me. Let’s get you cleaned up. I kind of want to talk away from the party for a minute too.
: Hm? Why?
: It’s loud in here, obviously. Let’s just hang out alone for a little while.
: Uhh...but I-
: Rin, come on! I need your help with my laces anyway. This corset’s too tight for me to bend over.
: Oohhhhh god! Okay! I can...get on the floor and...do that for you!
: I mean...we can find a bench if-
: I can get on the floor and do that for you!
Phase one — complete. Chika had managed to lure her “friend” away from the party and was now just three more phases away from tasting her again.
That wasn’t specifically why she was doing this, of course. She just happened to subconsciously plan out the steps it would take to get there and then even more subconsciously execute them.
So if the two of them just manage to get locked in some sort of storage closet together and then have to take their clothes off because it’s far too hot, it would be an accident.
Plans are really just that, though. Something you want to do, but ultimately fail at before the ever-present need to adapt takes over.
Chika used to believe she was good at that. After all, she adapted quite seamlessly to being the caretaker of a child when her mother died. And this was nowhere close to the tragedy that was.
But Chika was a different girl now than she was back then. And causing her to stumble at this point took little more than a poorly timed encounter.
: Oh!
: Oh?
: I think she means “hi.”
: Yes! Hi! I didn’t...realize you were coming.
: Work’s closed for Christmalloween. Figured I’d go where the food is. Know the room number by any chance? Noriko ain’t textin’ me back.
: Noriko? So you guys are...really that close now? You’re texting her? Without being texted first?
: I just asked her for the fuckin’ room number.
: Yes, but why not me? I’m here. Why was she the first one you reached out to?
: I don’t know. She ain’t ever tried to throw me off a balcony, for one.
: I feel like I should go. This appears to be a Chosoguchi problem that I need to stay out of.
: Chosoguchi?
: It’s the ship name I came up with for you guys when you used to hang out all the time and I would masturbate to fantasies about it.
: You did what?
: Please tell me I didn’t just say that out loud. You’re very pretty. I think I’m dying.
: And I think I am gonna fuck off to where the food is and pretend I didn’t ever hear that.
: I like Yumi’s idea! I think Chika should do that too and I should just go home!
: Rin, how about this? You go back to the room and I have a little chat with Yumi that you will not fantasize about. Okay?
: If that’s...okay with Yumi of course.
: Chika, you’ve already apologized for the crazy lady shit. You ain’t gotta do it again. I’m over it, okay?
: It’s not about that. I just...it’s been a while and...I could use somebody to talk to. Which is why I’ll fuck off if you say no. But also, please don’t say no. I’m kind of desperate.
: Ugh...fine. But only if you can promise me your friend here ain’t gonna write fuckin’ fan-fiction about this later.
: How did you know I wrote fan-fiction about you guys?!
: I mean...bye!
: Did we really need to come outside for this? It’s fuckin’ cold out here tonight.
: I had sex on this bench once.
: Cool. So, good talk, but I’m going to leave now.
: Wait, no! I’m just...nervous and didn’t know how else to make the atmosphere less bad!
: We could hold each other for warmth.
: Cool. So, good talk, but I ain’t about to make Rin’s fantasies become reality. Later, Chika.
: Wait, no! I’m just...nervous and didn’t know how else to make the atmosphere less bad!
: The fuck you gotta be nervous about? We both know you’d kick my ass if we actually wound up fighting.
: Yumi, I’m nervous because I am currently facing a crisis right now and the only person I can talk to about it is a friend who rightfully hates me after the way I treated her.
: I don’t hate you, Chika. It’s just fuckin’...hard bein’ around you now. You ain’t the same girl anymore and that shit...kinda sucks.
: All it takes is one more misunderstanding and shit between us is permanently fucked. So it’s safer to just fuckin’...leave it, right?
: It would be, yeah...And I know you’re doing fine without me, so if that’s what you want, then...that’s okay.
: But I’ve been struggling lately. And I kind of need an abrasive Yakuza princess to call me a fucking moron and snap me out of it.
: It ain’t about Chinami, is it?...
: No, Chinami is fine. This is, uhh...
: A much gayer problem.
: ...What?
: Yeaaaaah...
: The fuck you mean a “gayer” problem? You didn’t catch Sensei with a fuckin’ dude, did you? You sure it ain’t just another misunderstanding?
: No. But I...may have cheated on him. With a girl. Who I am now pretty sure I have a major crush on.
: And now I can’t stop thinking about her and it’s impacting my relationship with Sensei and she likes him too and I am pretty sure I am just going to die if I don’t figure this out soon!
: Chika...it’s not fuckin’ her is it? You did this with Rin?
: She was sad and horny! And I was angry and horny! That’s not a safe combination of things to encounter shortly after learning your boyfriend has fucked the entire class!
: That girl liked you forever and you turned her down. You tryin’ to tell me you’ve just magically changed your fuckin’ mind and now you’re into her?
: I don’t know! Yes?! I don’t want to be! But if I have to see her acting all cute one more time, I can not be held responsible for what I am going to do!
: Jesus fuckin’ Christ, Chika. We stop hangin’ out and you immediately convert to dykedom. Give me a fuckin’ break.

: I still love Sensei too. But that’s just one more reason it’s getting harder for me to convince myself that the only real love he has is the one he has for me when I have feelings for someone else now.
: Surprised you lasted this long. I was tryin’ to warn you about him forever. This shit was always bound to happen, Chika.
: Well...maybe without the lesbian part. But still.
: If you were me, what would you do?
: Well, I ain’t fuckin’ the girl...so that kinda only leaves one option if you’re makin’ me choose between ‘em.
: Assuming you did like girls though. Would you try and go for Rin? Stay with Sensei? Or...try to make both work even if it goes against everything you’ve ever thought about love?
: Didn’t you just say a couple minutes ago that Rin likes Sensei now? Ain’t gunnin’ for her just gonna confuse her? Especially after breakin’ her fuckin’ heart?
: It does confuse her. And I feel horrible about that.
: But I’m not really sure if she understands exactly how I’m feeling since it’s so fucking complicated that I don’t know how to talk about it without crying.
: Then she’s the one you’ve gotta talk to, Chika. Not me. I don’t know shit about romance and you know that.
: It’s less who I’m talking to and just...talking to someone in general that helps. Because if I didn’t get these feelings out, I probably would have just pulled her into a closet later and-
: Yeah, spare me the details. I don’t need to know about your weird closet fantasies. Just fuckin’...talk to her and...I guess text me again if you need more help not going insane.
: Thank you, Yumi...
: I really do miss you, you know...
: The apartment is so much quieter now. You can come back whenever you want. I know Chinami would love to see you.
: Yeah...maybe I can drop by again sometime. I don’t know.
: I’ve got enough going on right now. And I’ve been workin’ a lot, so...schedule’s kinda packed.
: I guess...I miss you guys too or...whatever, though.
: You can also vent if you want, Yumi. Unless...Noriko’s the one you’d rather talk to now.
: It’s all good, Chika. The only thing really worth writin’ home about is my mom getting cancer anyway.
: What?
: Yeah. Seems like she’s probably gonna live, though. So that’s good at least.
: Sorry. Didn’t mean to drag the mood down and shit.
: Your mom has cancer...
: And I ranted to you about my problems?
: I mean, how the fuck were you supposed to know? Ain’t something to get upset about. You ain’t ever liked her anyway.
: It doesn’t fucking matter how I feel Yumi. I didn’t even ask.
: I’ve been so focused on myself that it didn’t even occur to me that you might be struggling too...
: And with this...
: Of all things...
: What’s happened to me?...
: Is this really who I am now?...
: I don’t know, Chika. That’s somethin’ else I can’t help with.
: Yumi, I-
: I’m good, yo. You ain’t gotta worry about me.
: It ain’t wrong to focus on yourself if that’s what works for you.
: Now, if you don’t mind — I’m hungry as fuck. And I’m gonna go grab some food. Want me to send your girlfriend back down if I see her?
: Chika?
: I’m okay...
: Aight. Well, can’t say I didn’t try.
: See you up there, I guess. Tell the brat I said hi when you go back home.
: Okay...
: I’ll tell her...
Yumi leaves.
Chika is sad.
And it’s a violent sort of sadness. The kind that makes it next to impossible to breathe through your nose — where your head pounds and you start gagging due to the spasms in your throat.
She’d gotten used to crying lately. But it was never like this.
It was always just feeling like a failure. It was never actually seeing the consequences of that.
But she did tonight.
And she finally understood just how much she’d lost in her endless pursuit of happiness.
So she did what any girl her age would do.
She ran to the bathroom to cry some more.
And in there, she would cry, cry, and cry some more until the gagging was no longer just gagging.
Until her mascara ran so deeply down her cheeks that it dyed the collar of her brand new top.
The feel of the cold steel from her rings on her cheeks as she clawed at her eyes to fight off the tears was the closest she’d come to salvation that night.
But she’d fight that off too, punching the wall of a bathroom stall so hard that those rings would carve deep into the flesh of her fingers.
Now, she’d notice the pain every time they wound up between her legs.
This is what she deserved.
All of this and more.
